extensionDescription.message: ThunderAI Sparks is Thunderbird add-on, designed to add advanced features to ThunderAI.

prefsInfoDesc_1.message: ThunderAI Sparks is an experimental add-on for Thunderbird, designed to add advanced features to ThunderAI. To use this add-on you need to install ThunderAI.

prefsInfoDesc_2.message: Get ThunderAI from the Thunderbird Add-ons page!

TranslateText.message: Do you want to help translate ThunderAI and ThunderAI Sparks?

prefs_unavailable_event_calendar_info.message: The saved calendar is unavailable. Event creation will use an available calendar and warn you. Your saved preference is kept.

prefs_event_calendars_load_error.message: Calendars could not be loaded. Your saved preference has not been changed.

calendar_fallback_message.message: Your preferred calendar cannot accept new events. An available calendar has been selected instead. Review the calendar before saving; your preference has not been changed.

calendar_no_writable_events.message: No available calendar allows creating events. Enable a writable event calendar and try again.
